'''Sufian Tayeh''' ({{langx|ar|سفيان تايه|Sufyān Tāyah}}; 20 August 1971 – 2 December 2023), often spelled '''Sofyan Taya''' and also known as '''Abu Osama''', was a [[Palestinian]] scientist who served as president of the [[Islamic University of Gaza]] from August 2023 until his killing in December 2023.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |date=2023-07-08 |title=تعيين الأستاذ الدكتور سفيان عبد الرحمن تايه رئيساً للجامعة الإسلامية بغزة |url=https://qudsnet.com/post/555133/%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%8A%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B3%D8%AA%D8%A7%D8%B0-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%83%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%B1-%D8%B3%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%86-%D8%B9%D8%A8%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%AD%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%AA%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%87-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%A7-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%85%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A5%D8%B3%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A8%D8%BA%D8%B2%D8%A9 |access-date= |website=وكالة قدس نت للأنباء |language=ar}}</ref><ref name=":0"/>

Tayeh was a university professor and a researcher in [[physics]] and [[applied mathematics]]. He was killed, alongside all members of his family, in December 2023 by an [[Israel Defence Force]] airstrike.

==Early life and education==
Sufian Tayeh was born in 1971 in [[Jabalia refugee camp|Jabalia Camp]] of northern Gaza.<ref>{{cite news| author= |title=Head of Islamic University in Gaza killed in Israeli airstrike  |website=[[Anadolu Agency]] |url=https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/head-of-islamic-university-in-gaza-killed-in-israeli-airstrike/3071578 |date=7 December 2023 |access-date= |archive-date=}}</ref> He received his primary education in the [[UNRWA]] school in the camp. He obtained a [[Bachelor's degree]] in Physics from the Islamic University of Gaza in 1994 and in the same year he began working for the university.<ref>{{Citation |title=الأستاذ الدكتور سفيان تايه قصة يُفتخر بها... |date= January 2022|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8li4fySXCJI |access-date=15 December 2023 |language=en}}</ref>

==Career==
He was a leading researcher in [[physics]] and [[applied mathematics]].<ref name="reuters">{{cite news| author= |title=Israeli air strike in Gaza kills prominent scientist Sufyan Tayeh, Palestinian ministry says  |website=[[Reuters]] |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-air-strike-gaza-kills-prominent-scientist-sufyan-tayeh-palestinian-2023-12-02/ |date=7 December 2023 |access-date= |archive-date=}}</ref> Tayeh was winner of the Palestine Islamic Bank Award for Scientific Research for the years 2019 and 2020, recipient of the Abdul Hameed Shoman Award for Young Arab Scientists and the Islamic University Award for Scientific Research for the year 2021.<ref>{{cite news |author= |title=In Memoriam Sufyan Tayeh 
|website=[[ICTP]]  |url=https://www.ictp.it/news/2023/12/memoriam |date=8 December 2023 |access-date= |archive-date=}}</ref>

Tayeh's research interests included [[optical waveguide]]s, optical waveguide [[Sensor|sensing]], [[ellipsometry]], [[dye-sensitized solar cell]]s, and [[OLED]]s.<ref name="google-scholar">{{cite web| url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=U4MuxawAAAAJ | title=Prof. Dr. Sofyan Taya | website=[[Google Scholar]] | accessdate=5 April 2024 }}</ref> He was still research-active at the time of his killing.

== Death ==

He was killed in an airstrike on a residential building by the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] during the [[Gaza War]].<ref name=":0">{{cite news| url=https://www.palestinechronicle.com/israel-kills-top-palestinian-scientist-president-of-islamic-university-with-whole-family-in-gaza/ | title=Israel Kills Top Palestinian Scientist, President of Islamic University, with Whole Family in Gaza | work=The Palestine Chronicle | date=2 December 2023 | accessdate=5 April 2024 }}</ref><ref name="reuters" />
